def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    orient,line=find_line(grid)
    lc=grid[line][0] if orient=='h' else grid[0][line]
    bg=0 if any(0 in r for r in grid) else 1
    cells=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
           if grid[r][c] not in (bg,lc) and ((orient=='h' and r!=line) or (orient=='v' and c!=line))]
    o=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for r,c,v in cells: o[r][c]=bg
    rs=[r for r,c,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c,_ in cells]
    if orient=='h':
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); h=r1-r0+1
        if line<r0: nr=line+1; row8=nr+h
        else: nr=line-h; row8=nr-1
        for r,c,v in cells: o[nr+r-r0][c]=v
        for c in range(W): o[row8][c]=8
    else:
        c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs); w=c1-c0+1
        if line<c0: nc=line+1; col8=nc+w
        else: nc=line-w; col8=nc-1
        for r,c,v in cells: o[r][nc+c-c0]=v
        for r in range(H): o[r][col8]=8
    return o
